patches.summary: Add safe stdin token setup, env-token persistence protection, and stdin-first guidance for auth set-token.
patches.reason: The generated argv-only token setup can expose tokens through shell history and process lists. The preview needs a safer config-file path while preserving legacy argv compatibility, and stdin saves must not persist an env token imported during config load.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli covers stdin save, env-token non-persistence, empty stdin rejection, and stdin-first help/status guidance.

patches.summary: Adapt provenance-backed generated read output from results/meta to the target agent envelope.
patches.reason: Generated read commands route JSON output through wrapWithProvenance. Updating that helper reduces the agent JSON launch blocker without mass-editing generated command files.
patches.validated_outcome: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli covers valid JSON payloads under data, non-JSON payloads as strings under data, empty warnings, null pagination, null trace_id, null error, and removal of results/meta.
